title: Replication Package: Every Added Test Raises the Mutation Score: A Pitfall in Evaluating Mutation Testing on Bug Fixes, and a Kill-Matrix Protocol
description: Replication package for a methods note on evaluating mutation testing with real bug fixes. Includes the experiment harness (PIT 1.16 with the full kill matrix, Surefire-based fault detection), the raw PIT and Surefire reports for 10 bug-fix pairs from Apache Commons Lang, the per-pair results, the naive-vs-placebo analysis, the equal-size test-subset analysis, and the scripts that generate every figure, table and number of the paper from the measured data.
